title.zh: 将保和省比拉尔市镇的马宁高街与华盛顿街分别更名为马塞洛·H·德尔皮拉尔街与马格塞塞街的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Names of Maningaw and Washington Streets in the Municipality of Bilar, Province of Bohol, to Marcelo H. Del Pilar Street and Magsaysay Street, Respectively
title.orig: An Act Changing the Names of Maningaw and Washington Streets in the Municipality of Bilar, Province of Bohol, to Marcelo H. Del Pilar Street and Magsaysay Street, Respectively

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1960/ra_2838_1960.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The names of Maningaw Street and Washington Street in the Municipality of Bilar, Province of Bohol, are hereby changed to Marcelo H. del Pilar Street and Magsaysay Street, respectively.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 19, 1960.
